name: get-issue
description: Gets one Linear issue with up to 50 of its comments: title, description, state, priority, assignee, team, project and labels. Takes the issue's identifier (like ENG-123) or id, from linear__list-my-issues or linear__find-issues.

id.description: The issue's identifier, like ENG-123, or its id, from linear__list-my-issues or linear__find-issues.
